The official OpenAI deprecations page is at developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations. The search surfaced snippets of it, plus third-party write-ups that mostly restate it. Those snippets show these dates:

- **Aug 10, 2026:** the gpt-5.2-chat-latest and gpt-5.3-chat-latest snapshots, with gpt-5.5 as the recommended replacement. Shutdown date Aug 10, 2026 for gpt-5.2-chat-latest and gpt-5.3-chat-latest, recommended replacement gpt-5.5
- **Aug 26, 2026:** the Assistants API, with the Responses API and Conversations API as replacements. OpenAI's deprecations page gives 26 August 2026 as the Assistants API shutdown date, with the Responses API and Conversations API as replacements.
- **Sep 24, 2026:** the Videos API and sora-2 models. One third-party table lists no replacement for this entry. 24 September 2026 Videos API and sora-2, sora-2-pro and their dated snapshots None listed
- **Oct 23, 2026:** the largest batch, covering legacy GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o, o1 and o4-mini snapshots, along with gpt-image-1 and fine-tuned variants. On October 23 a further set of legacy GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4.1 Nano, GPT-4o, and o-series snapshots and aliases, along with gpt-image-1 and several fine-tuned base-model families.
- **Nov 30, 2026:** the v1/prompts API and reusable prompt objects, plus the Evals dashboard and API. The official page lists both. Nov 30, 2026: The v1/prompts API and reusable prompt objects are scheduled to shut down. Nov 30, 2026: The Evals dashboard and API are scheduled to shut down.
- **Dec 1, 2026:** gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest. Dec 1, 2026 for gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest, with gpt-image-2 as the recommended replacement
- **Dec 11, 2026:** the original GPT-5 and o3 snapshots, per a third-party guide. 11 December 2026 for the original GPT-5 and o3 snapshots
- **Jan 20, 2027:** a legacy audio and realtime removal that one third-party guide cites. A separate source says it is not on OpenAI's page. One thing you may have read is not on OpenAI's page anywhere: a 20 January 2027 removal of legacy audio, realtime and transcription families. We checked the page today and it is not there.

Caveats: the July 23, 2026 batch has already passed. Third-party sources disagree on some details, so the official page is the authority. OpenAI can also revise dates and replacement recommendations, so re-check the live page before relying on these dates. The snapshots I saw were from various dates, and I could not confirm the official page's current state.


REMINDER: You MUST include the sources above in your response to the user using markdown hyperlinks.

content.text:
The official page is **[developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations)**. I couldn't open it directly because my fetch tool was refused, so the dates below come from search-result snippets and some third-party write-ups. Check the live page before you rely on them.

**Next retirement (today is 2026-10-16): October 23, 2026.** This is the largest batch. It covers:
- legacy GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4.1 Nano and GPT-4o snapshots and aliases
- o-series snapshots such as o1 and o4-mini
- gpt-image-1
- several fine-tuned base-model families

I couldn't confirm the exact model list or the recommended replacements for this batch.

**After that:**
- **Nov 30, 2026:** the v1/prompts API and reusable prompt objects, plus the Evals dashboard and API.
- **Dec 1, 2026:** gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest. The recommended replacement is gpt-image-2.
- **Dec 11, 2026:** the original GPT-5 and o3 snapshots. This date comes only from a third-party guide.
- **Jan 20, 2027:** a legacy audio, realtime and transcription removal. One source says this is not on OpenAI's page, so treat it as unconfirmed.

Sources:
- [OpenAI Deprecations (official)](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations.md)
- [Official deprecations index](https://developers.openai.com/docs/deprecations)
